## Goal

Every D26 library is one import away, themed by the tokens, and the live chart stays smooth at high rates.

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- token-aware wrappers: Recharts 3 through shadcn charts, a uPlot live chart with append-mode `useLive`, ECharts 6, TanStack Table 9, Mermaid 12, `@xyflow/react` 12, Excalidraw, MapLibre with deck.gl, react-three-fiber, Shiki and CodeMirror 6, KaTeX;
- the warm set and on-demand set as D65 defines them;
- license and version re-verification recorded in VERIFIED_FACTS;
- components for presence, cursors, a respondent tracker and attribution, on WP-31's hooks and restylable (KT-11).

Design detail for this package:

- Token-aware wrappers per library; warm set versus on-demand per D65.
- uPlot live chart on `useLive` append mode; set and measure the target rate (at least 60 updates per second with 10k points on CI hardware).
- License and version re-verification recorded in VERIFIED_FACTS.
- Team components (KT-11, D121): presence avatars, live cursors, a respondent tracker and attribution chips, built on WP-31's hooks, reading the tokens and accepting `className` (KT-10).
- From WP-31 (D168, INTERFACES §2.3): `useRespondents()` gives `self`, and under the manifest's `team.visibility` `counts` and `complete` (`counts`) or every `Respondent` (`names`), each with `status` (`not-opened`, `drafting`, `submitted`) and `openedAt`/`submittedAt`; `usePresence({ cursor?, selection? })` gives `others` (`PresencePeer`: `cursor` in document coordinates, `selection` as a `data-presence-id`, `id` or `name`) and `count`; an artifact-scoped field's `meta.updatedBy` is `{ kind, name?, key?, self?, at? }`. A person's `key` (`vk_…`) is the same in all three, so a chip, an avatar and a cursor of one person match. Components render what the hook gives for the visibility in force and nothing more (`private` shows only the viewer's own entry), and draw on `status: "unavailable"` (outside a live page, and in `verify`) without data. The fixtures of `packages/runtime/test/fixtures/artifacts/team` and `tests/e2e/fixtures/team` show each shape.
- From WP-18 (D181): the kit is `@mostra/kit`. Its parts are shadcn 4.23.0's own output for both bases (`packages/kit/upstream/shadcn/`, pinned by SHA-256), restyled by one rule table (`scripts/studio.ts`) into `registry/<base>/` by `scripts/generate.ts`, which also emits the kit's own modules (`KIT_ITEMS`: `mostra-questionnaire`, `mostra-layout`) as items an artifact resolves without copying (`@mostra/kit/<module>` or `@/components/mostra/<module>`) or copies with `mostra add`. Build each wrapper the same way: a kit module, its registry item in both bases, reading the token contract (`packages/themes/src/tokens.ts`: `--chart-1` to `--chart-6` in their fixed order, the surface, shape and type tokens) so every theme in a stack restyles it, and the specimen (`skills/mostra/assets/examples/specimen`, its Radix twin `packages/runtime/test/fixtures/artifacts/specimen-radix`) showing it; `kit-parts.test.ts` verifies the specimen in both bases and both built-in themes, and `kit.spec.ts`'s restyle check requires every visible part to change under a layer that changes only tokens. Verify's lint (`packages/runtime/src/verify/lint.ts`, `MOSTRA_LINT_API_CHANGED` with a replace fix, `mostra verify --fix`) already covers TanStack Table 8, Mermaid's deprecated `init` and `mermaidAPI.render`, `reactflow` and Tailwind 3: extend it for each library this package wraps, and the Skill's "write this, not that" table in `references/libraries.md` with it.
- From WP-18: `@xyflow/react` 13.0 shipped on 2026-11-17 while the warm set pins 12.12.0 (VERIFIED_FACTS, WP-18): decide its major with the wrapper, past the release age, and add the 12-to-13 changes to the lint and the Skill.
- Issue #219 (on this package's milestone, from WP-18): `mostra add` of a shadcn `base-nova` or `radix-nova` item by URL writes it as shadcn's registry serves it, with the `IconPlaceholder` element and the `cn-*` markers that shadcn's CLI rewrites on install, so the copied part doesn't build; the kit's own parts and names are unaffected (they are the CLI's output). Transform them in `packages/runtime/src/packs/` as shadcn 4.23.0 does (the icon library from `components.json`, lucide by default), with a test as strict as `packs.test.ts`'s byte-for-byte comparison against shadcn's own output.
- Issue #242 (on this package's milestone, from WP-18's release check): a `Questionnaire`'s title inside a `Page` is set at the page title's size, and a lone `Button` in a `Page` spans the column; give the questionnaire's title the section heading's size inside a `Page` (the page can say so through context) and keep `Page`'s children at their own width, with a screenshot check in both themes.

## Acceptance evidence

a render test per library in three browsers; the uPlot path holds the target rate (target set in the WP spec from a measured baseline, at least 60 updates per second with 10k points on CI hardware) without frame drops beyond the budget; the license audit stays green; each team component renders from fixtures in both themes and accepts `className` (KT-11).

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- `@xyflow/react` has a new major (13); TanStack Table 9 and Mermaid 12's churn guidance exists (WP-18) and grows with each wrapper.
